independence

Although college-age students are typically associated with youthful and carefree behaviors, they also possess qualities of independence. With more freedom than any other generation, the young have the ability to make their own choices. This means that they spend money more freely on their own discretion. Unlike their parents, these young people are not as concerned about finances and can make purchases without second guessing their budget. College age students are also generally open to new experiences and are willing to try different products.

Price versus value

Besides the willingness to spend money freely, college-age students tend to make their purchases based on price and value. Unlike their parents, the youth of today are less influenced by brand names. They seek out better deals instead of the latest and greatest brands. Moreover, because these young people are more independent and willing to try new things, they are more likely to buy value-branded products rather than higher-priced well-known brand names.

Environmental awareness

Although environmental consciousness is not a new phenomenon, it is still an important part of the shopping behavior of college-age students. Due to the fact that most young adults were raised by the environmentally-friendly baby boomers and eco-savvy parents, many of them are committed to a greener future. Thus, they are inclined to purchase more eco-friendly and environmentally-conscious products.

Social shopping

An increasing trend for today’s youth is the importance of social shopping. Due to the rise of online retailers, shoppers are able to compare prices and read reviews on product ratings and performance. The ability to seek out information on potential products makes the young generation more confident in their purchases.

For this research paper, the ZIP code 75210 of Dallas in Texas, United States will be analyzed. For that, the census data and some demographic information provided by the United States Census Bureau (Census Bureau) will be used. One should note that the Census Bureau does not collect information on ZIP codes, but data on areas, the census tracts. Nevertheless, the information about certain areas available can be used as an estimation of the differences between ZIP codes.

It is important to state that the ZIP code 75210 of Dallas, where the proposed analysis of the social differences will be conducted, is a small area, which has a population density that is about 47 times higher than that of the rest of the US, and the median household income is more than 3.5 times that of the entire country. These factors indicate that social differences exist in the ZIP code 75210 and, therefore, the examination should take into account both the location and the income of the residents.

With regard to education, the situation is also interesting. According to the information provided by the Census Bureau, the percentage of bachelor's degree holders in Dallas and the rest of the US is 25.3% and 31%, respectively, meaning that the ZIP code 75210 has about 17% fewer bachelor's degree holders than the rest of the United States. On the other hand, the percentages of people aged 25 or more with at least a high school degree differ little between the Dallas area, in general, and the rest of the US (18.7% versus 18.9%).

including Haiti, women suffer great hardships from cultural and religious traditions that often prevent women from receiving an education or the proper medical care that is essential to the survival of both herself and her baby.  According to the Women and Children First organization, women in Haiti have very high rates of death during childbirth compared to the women of other nations. The reasons for the extremely high mortality rate are complex and are due to lack of education, limited access to pre-natal care, malnourishment, over-population, lack of access to proper medical equipment and trained medical personnel, cultural beliefs that result in the women being forced to deliver babies at home, and women being treated as subordinates.

Statistics and Causes of Maternal Mortality in Haiti

The statistics on maternal mortality in Haiti are grim. According to the Women and Children First organization, for every 100 live births in Haiti, twenty women will die in childbirth, which is the highest in the Western hemisphere.  According to the World Health Organization, maternal mortality rates in Haiti are 600 deaths for every 100,000 live births, while the maternal mortality rate in the United States is 14 deaths for every 100,000 live births. The Women and Children First organization states that the leading causes of death are bleeding after childbirth, infection of the uterus, and blood pressure complications caused by the high rate of malnutrition in Haiti (http://www.wcfonline.org/).

This will result in more appropriate interventions and public policies to be implemented by nurses in order to prevent substance abuse. Based on this framework, the current essay will examine the public health concern of drugs and substance abuse within the city of Melbourne. It will describe the characteristics of the city of Melbourne, examine the social risk factors contributing to the issue, and describe the current policies and resources to address the issue within the city of Melbourne. The paper will also describe the role and responsibilities of nurses to address the issue, and conclude with relevant references.

Characteristics of the City of Melbourne

The city of Melbourne is located in Florida within Broward County (Florida Statutes, 2018). It has a population of 54,162 residents with a 5.7% population growth and a density of 3,378 people per square mile (City of Melbourne, 2017). This city is the home of the Melbourne International Airport and has an area of 14.56 square miles. It is a beach community located on the east coast of Florida (City of Melbourne, 2017). In 2008, the median home value in this community was $153,000, and the population had a 7.8% growth rate (Florida Statutes, 2018). Approximately 18.9% of the residents are from a foreign country, 3.7% is of Hispanic or Latino descent, and the median household income in this community was $61,481 (City of Melbourne, 2017).

large commercial breweries have had significant market share in the Canadian brewing industry, they have been in trouble due to the increasing competition from microbreweries (Cunningham, 2006).

The increased competition from the microbreweries is partly due to the increased quality of microbreweries (Judd, 2004). In addition, many consumers prefer the microbreweries to the large commercial ones on account of their “image” (Cunningham, 2006). Consumers also like the microbreweries because their products are unique and are not available elsewhere (Cunningham, 2006).

In addition, microbreweries have a high turnover (Cunningham, 2006). Unlike the commercial breweries that take months to brew a given product, the microbreweries can brew a given product in a matter of days or even hours. This means that the microbreweries have the capacity to produce speciality products for their clients. In addition, because they are small, the microbreweries are able to produce small quantities of the specialty products and yet remain profitable (Cunningham, 2006).

Because of these qualities, the demand for products of the microbreweries has increased especially in the position market (Cunningham, 2006). As a result, the market share of the commercial breweries has decreased considerably (Hoover’s Incorporated, 2007). The competition from the microbreweries has forced the giant commercial breweries to restructure their operations.

The two major commercial breweries have responded to the competition from the microbreweries in various ways.

operates with no other objectives other than to make profits will hardly achieve much and sooner or later, they will sink into irrelevance (John & Sikora, 1996). This is why the establishment of a business needs to be done after much thought. It is imperative that businesses establish objectives. This is not for the sake of it. Objectives are there to define purpose and to act as a guideline when making decisions.

A business owner needs to ensure that their business will be successful and at the same time, they need to know what success looks like. Therefore, businesses have objectives. They outline the main goal or goals of a particular company and at the same time, act as a roadmap to the future of the business.

Objectives of Business

Business objectives are critical in the functioning of a business. This is because they provide the purpose of the business. Without purpose, a business will be like a ship without a destination, sailing for no reason. Objectives ensure that a business understands what it is doing. It helps business owners, employees and any stakeholder understand where the business is heading. This in turn helps them plan and develop strategies on how the business will achieve its objectives. There are different types of objectives that businesses can develop. The most important objectives that businesses need to have are the:

• Profit maximization objective
• Loss reduction objective
• Market expansion objective
• Sales revenue growth objective
• Employee growth objective
• Social responsibility objective

All businesses aim to earn profits. This is a fundamental objective that businesses have. They need to earn money to pay the owners and investors. They also need money to run operations. Without money, businesses cannot function. They therefore aim to make money. To this end, they establish businesses to sell products and services to make a profit.

The profit objective is, however, not the only goal that a business has.

Abstract

The restaurant industry has experienced a remarkable growth and development in Nigeria, mainly driven by the increasing purchasing power of Nigerian households. In addition, the growth of the industry has also been driven by rapid growth in the number of households and individuals, that are employed in the formal and informal sectors of the economy. The rapid growth in this market creates an opportunity for the foreign businesses to expand their operations in Nigeria (Cherry, 2015).

The purpose of this paper is to determine the most appropriate strategies that Pizza Express can use to enter the Nigerian market. The emerging technologies have turned the world into a small global village, and firms are struggling to expand their market share by finding new international markets. In order to penetrate and remain competitive in a new market, a company has to evaluate its internal and external environments and develop the most suitable strategies that will ensure it survives, grows, and gains a competitive advantage over its competitors.

This paper begins with a brief review of the market conditions that are expected to prevail in Nigeria in the future. In the future, there is an expected growth in the middle class that will increase the purchasing power of the average Nigerian.

different ways in which music was traditionally used in Christian worship are discussed. In the first part of this research paper, it is discussed how music was used to teach and encourage believers. The second discussion explores how traditional Christian worship music was used to exhibit dedication to God.

Traditionally, Christian worship services were highly educational and informative. One of the primary purposes of Christian worship service music is to help believers to learn about the teachings of the Bible. The music usually contained important messages that provided insights into the various teachings of the Bible. The use of music in Christian worship services played a significant role in the delivery of spiritual messages. The messages delivered by the preachers were sometimes difficult to understand. As a result, the inclusion of music was a critical instrument that helped in making the delivery of spiritual messages easier (Goff 56). The music delivered relevant messages that made the teaching easier to understand. It also provided a deeper understanding of the teachings that were delivered. For example, Christians were taught not to be materialistic, and the love of money should not take them to the path of wickedness. Music played a significant role in educating the church members on the different teachings about money and how to live an honest life. The use of music in traditional Christian worship service made the service more interesting and easier to understand (Levin 33). Music has also been used to teach the believers about forgiveness. Christians were taught that it is wrong to hold grudges against people. The music helped to educate them on the consequences of holding grudges against people.

by several nursing leaders is based on clinical and scientific literature and uses their expert insight to educate other practitioners about fall prevention, in the intensive care unit (ICU). The authors use both quantitative and qualitative research, in order to educate the readers.
  * Main Points * The focus of the article is to create patient safety in the critical care setting and to keep the patients in the ICU mobile, in order to decrease length of stay and increase patient safety.
  * Purpose * The authors wrote this article to present to other critical care nurses the importance of keeping the patient mobile and preventing the patient from falling during their hospital stay.
  * Keywords * Critical care unit, patient safety, falls, nursing leadership, health care reform, patient care
  * Evidence This article presented evidence for both patient safety and a quality health care reform. Both are the driving forces in critical care units and all health care reform in the United States.
  * Conclusion The authors, all nursing leaders, wrote this article to stress the importance of creating safe environments for critical care patients who are both in danger of falling and need to maintain their mobility.

Azzopardi, M., & McGrath, M. (2010). The impact of education on falls prevention by nurses in an acute hospital. Nursing in Critical Care, 15, 4, 260-264.

  * Abstract This is a descriptive study of nurse leaders that educate the staff at The Royal Melbourne Hospital in Melbourne, Australia. This study focuses on staff education and fall prevention within the ICU setting.
  * Methodology This is a qualitative study that focuses on the nurses’ perspective in fall prevention.

birthday for both Google and Wolfram|Alpha.

However, they are quite different products; Google is a general search engine for web pages, where Wolfram|Alpha can only compute data on predetermined subjects. Google is a vast network of information, where Wolfram|Alpha contains pre-calculated data in a vast database of subjects.

With the goal of providing a search engine that could compete in the same league as Wolfram|Alpha, Google has created a tool that fuses the two. It is dubbed Goofram.

Description of the Community

Wolfram|Alpha was launched in the United States on May 18, 2009 as a web service to be accessed through the Internet. The service is available through the Wolfram|Alpha website in the form of a text box (search input) and buttons for navigation (search output). It is also available as a web service for use with third party client programs, and as a widget for the social networking site Facebook. [1]

Wolfram|Alpha was officially released in other countries on May 19, 2009. [2]

Wolfram|Alpha, known also as Alpha or Wolfram Alpha, is an online computational knowledge engine and answer engine service created by computer scientist Stephen Wolfram. Its core data comes from Wolfram Research‘s proprietary data curation and structured data capturing systems (which can be found in their Wolfram Data Repository), in combination with the scientific and mathematical database Wolfram|Alpha (which can be found in the Wolfram Knowledgebase).[3]

Wolfram|Alpha can compute results that go far beyond what is possible with a typical search engine because it has native understanding of the underlying meaning of information in natural language queries.
